title: The Career Choice Gap — Research Report No. 2
description: More than one in five young Indian graduates who want work cannot find it (22.3%, PLFS 2025). Youth unemployment by education and gender; diploma holders show lower unemployment and more salaried work than graduates, though this does not prove a diploma is the better choice.
target_audience: Students choosing between a degree and a diploma, parents, teachers and counsellors
questions_it_answers: How many graduates in India are unemployed?
How do diploma and degree holders compare on unemployment?
Why are graduates unemployed in India?
What is the youth unemployment rate in India?
How many jobs have a written contract?
